about.title: Your musical identity, documented like a journey.
about.introduction: SoundPassport turns your listening taste into a playful digital passport filled with favorite songs, musical destinations, and details worth sharing.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Authorize access securely through Spotify's official sign-in page.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We read your listening affinities and turn them into meaningful musical details.

steps.title: Explore
steps.description: Browse a personal passport with anthems, destinations, and more pages as SoundPassport grows.

about.privacyDescription: SoundPassport uses Spotify's official Web API and OAuth authorization flow. You choose which permissions to grant on Spotify's own authorization screen.
about.passwordDescription: Your Spotify password is never shared with or seen by SoundPassport. Spotify handles the entire sign-in process and returns a limited access token instead.
about.permissionsDescription: The app requests read-only access to your basic profile, top listening data, and recently played music. It cannot change your library, control playback, publish content, or access your payment details.
about.faqTitle: A few things you may be wondering.

faq.question: What does SoundPassport create?
faq.answer: It turns your listening data into a digital music passport with an identity page, fictional travel stamps, and your national anthems.

faq.question: Does SoundPassport know my Spotify password?
faq.answer: No. You sign in directly with Spotify. SoundPassport never receives, sees, or stores your Spotify password.

faq.question: What information can the app access?
faq.answer: Only the read-only information listed on Spotify's permission screen, currently your basic profile, top listening data, and recently played music.

faq.question: Can SoundPassport modify my Spotify account?
faq.answer: No. The requested permissions do not allow the app to edit your library, follow artists, create playlists, or control playback.

faq.question: Why might my passport differ from Spotify Wrapped?
faq.answer: Spotify provides affinity rankings for specific time ranges, not complete play counts or the same private calculations used by Wrapped. SoundPassport presents the data currently available through the official API.

privacy.title: Clear, limited, and under your control.
privacy.introduction: SoundPassport only requests the Spotify access needed to build your music passport. This page explains what happens to that access in the current version of the app.

sections.title: Official Spotify authorization
sections.description: You connect through Spotify's official OAuth authorization page. SoundPassport never receives or sees your Spotify password.

sections.title: Permissions requested
sections.description: The current app requests read-only permissions. These permissions cannot be used to modify your Spotify account.
items: Read your top artists and tracks

sections.title: How your session is handled
sections.description: Spotify access and refresh tokens are encrypted and stored in an HTTP-only cookie in your browser. The cookie is unavailable to page scripts and is configured to expire after 30 days.

sections.title: Listening data and storage
sections.description: SoundPassport keeps a successful passport snapshot in temporary server memory. It is reused for 12 hours and may be used as a fallback for up to 7 days if Spotify is unavailable. No access token is stored in this cache, it is cleared on disconnect, and it disappears when the server restarts. Public artist names may be sent to MusicBrainz for genre metadata; no Spotify token or account identifier is shared. Passports are not made public automatically.

sections.title: Disconnecting and revoking access
sections.description: Disconnecting deletes the SoundPassport session cookie from your browser. You can separately revoke the app's authorization at any time from your Spotify account apps page.

privacy.controlTitle: You can revoke access at any time.
privacy.controlDescription: Manage authorized apps directly through Spotify or contact Saul if you have a privacy question about SoundPassport.
